items.prompt: For post-step spots 80 and 120 with K=100, which path payoff is required?

options.text: 20, using only the terminal positive payoff.
options.why: That replaces the average-spot payoff by a terminal call payoff.
The arithmetic average is 100, so this path payoff is zero.

options.text: 10, the mean of individual positive payoffs.
options.why: A nonlinear positive part cannot be moved inside the average.

options.text: 40, the range of observed path prices.
options.why: A path range is not the Asian call payoff.

items.explanation: The arithmetic average is 100, so this path payoff is zero.
